name: ai_document_storage
problem: Users upload documents the AI must read; raw files and derived text/vectors must be linked and access-controlled.
glue: files_core stores the original (storage_adapters + signed_urls); an ingestion job extracts text and hands it to the AI/embeddings pipeline; access checks reuse the owning user's permissions.
steps: uploads accepts the file; storage_adapters persists it; record file_id + owner.
A background job (jobs_core) extracts text and triggers embeddings.
Serve originals via signed_urls; never expose raw storage paths.
